scripts.db:backup: powershell -Command "if (!(Test-Path backups)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory backups } ; $ts = Get-Date -Format yyyyMMdd_HHmmss ; docker exec rentflow-postgres pg_dump -U rentflow -F c -f /tmp/rentflow_$ts.backup rentflow ; docker cp rentflow-postgres:/tmp/rentflow_$ts.backup ./backups/rentflow_$ts.backup"
scripts.db:restore: powershell -Command "$f = Get-ChildItem backups\*.backup | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1 ; docker cp $f.FullName rentflow-postgres:/tmp/rentflow.backup ; docker exec rentflow-postgres pg_restore -U rentflow -d rentflow --clean --if-exists /tmp/rentflow.backup"
scripts.minio:backup: powershell -Command "if (!(Test-Path backups)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory backups } ; $ts = Get-Date -Format yyyyMMdd_HHmmss ; docker cp rentflow-minio:/data ./backups/minio_temp ; Compress-Archive -Path backups\minio_temp\* -DestinationPath backups\minio_$ts.zip ; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force backups\minio_temp"
scripts.minio:restore: powershell -Command "$f = Get-ChildItem backups\minio_*.zip | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1 ; if (Test-Path backups\minio_temp) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force backups\minio_temp } ; Expand-Archive $f.FullName -DestinationPath backups\minio_temp ; docker compose up -d ; docker cp backups\minio_temp\. rentflow-minio:/data ; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force backups\minio_temp ; docker compose restart minio"
scripts.backup:all: npm run db:backup && npm run minio:backup
scripts.restore:all: npm run minio:restore && npm run db:restore
scripts.clean:comments: npx jscodeshift -t ./scripts/remove-all-comments.js frontend/app frontend/components frontend/features frontend/lib frontend/hooks frontend/context frontend/middlewares backend/src --extensions=js,jsx,ts,tsx --parser=tsx --run-in-band --ignore-pattern "**/.next/**" --ignore-pattern "**/node_modules/**" --ignore-pattern "**/public/**" --ignore-pattern "**/prisma/**"
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean:comments && prettier --write frontend/app frontend/components frontend/features frontend/lib frontend/hooks frontend/context frontend/middlewares backend/src
